name: Occidental-Bajada
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by massive canyon systems near the terminator.
Vacuum carries no sound at all; the loudest thing on this world is your own pulse inside the suit.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
